how_to_apply: Apply only through the Samvardhan Path - Online Portal for Departmental Selection, linked on www.westerncoal.in under Careers > Departmental Selection.
Register on the portal using NEIS No. and other credentials prompted.
Log in with NEIS No., password, the post applied for and the OTP received on mobile.
Fill educational and technical qualification; personal and service details are auto-fetched.
Upload photograph, signature and self-attested scanned documents, not more than 5 MB each.
Submit online; the application is forwarded to the Unit In-Charge or SE section (WCL HQ).

content_sections.heading: How Will WCL Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Clerk, Grade III and Store Issue Clerk, Grade III: Common Aptitude Test followed by separate Computer Proficiency Tests Jr. Data Entry Operator, T&S Gr. E: Aptitude Test of Computer Applications followed by Typing Speed Test Empanelment on the basis of merit Aptitude Test (Objective Type): 90 minutes, 100 questions, 100 marks Computer Proficiency Test for Clerk Grade III covers MS Word, MS Powerpoint and MS Excel; for Store Issue Clerk Grade III MS Word and MS Excel Typing Speed Test for Jr. DEO: 10 minutes, minimum 30 words per minute Clerk and Store Issue Clerk merit: Aptitude + CPT marks + qualification marks (PG 10, UG 7, Intermediate 5, Matriculate 3) Jr. DEO merit: Aptitude Test of Computer Applications marks of those who qualify in typing Tie: earlier date of appointment first, then elder by date of birth

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for WCL Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply only through the Samvardhan Path - Online Portal for Departmental Selection, linked on www.westerncoal.in under Careers > Departmental Selection. Register on the portal using NEIS No. and other credentials prompted. Log in with NEIS No., password, the post applied for and the OTP received on mobile. Fill educational and technical qualification; personal and service details are auto-fetched. Upload photograph, signature and self-attested scanned documents, not more than 5 MB each. Submit online; the application is forwarded to the Unit In-Charge or SE section (WCL HQ). Apply on or before 1 December 2026.
